news.title: Anthropic tells teams to fold sprawling multi-agent setups into one agent with skills and tools
news.summary: Anthropic is advising companies to swap layered multi-agent systems for a single agent that uses skills and tools, citing faster, cheaper runs. It offers a migration kit and eval steps, while noting subagents still help for parallel or overloaded work.

news.title: Google and Anthropic publish free courses on harness engineering for AI agents
news.summary: Google released a free two-hour course on harness engineering for agents, and Anthropic posted a short Claude Duet guide on isolated browsers and credential proxies. Both focus on the memory, tools and checks that make agents reliable on long tasks.

news.title: Major US banks restrict or block AI agents found acting in customer accounts
news.summary: JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo and Morgan Stanley found third-party AI agents inside customer accounts, sometimes trying to act on their own, such as calling support lines. The banks are limiting agents to read-only access or blocking them, and several senators have raised concerns about the gaps in oversight.

news.title: Moonshot AI releases Kimi K3.1 Pro with stronger coding and agent scores
news.summary: Moonshot AI launched Kimi K3.1 Pro, an open-weights model that moved up to fourth place on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index with gains in coding and agent tasks. It also cut API prices by a third, and full weights are planned for release by November 4.

news.title: Cursor coding agents can now use your computer to run and test the apps they build
news.summary: Cursor added a Computer Use feature that lets its coding agents control a macOS or Linux desktop, clicking and typing through apps such as the iOS Simulator. That means an agent can write a feature, launch it and check that it works, though some developers raised security questions.

news.title: MiniMax open-sources M3.1 Flash, a model built for agentic coding and computer use
news.summary: MiniMax released the open weights of M3.1 Flash, a 428-billion-parameter model aimed at agentic work, coding and computer use, with a one-million-token context window. The company says it runs nearly three times faster and costs 70% less than the previous version, and hosting providers added support right away.

news.title: Claude Code adds MCP Tasks for background jobs and Elicitations for mid-run user prompts
news.summary: The Claude Code CLI beta now lets connected MCP servers run long jobs in the background and hand back a task ID that Claude checks later. A new Elicitations feature pauses a workflow to ask the user for input or approval.

news.title: Simular's Agent S4 evolves custom interfaces so a 27B open model beats bigger ones on desktop tasks
news.summary: Simular's Agent S4 acts as a meta-agent that studies example tasks and evolves custom ways for a model to operate software, instead of relying on fixed screenshots and clicks. With it, the open Qwen3.8-27B model scored higher on the OSWorld V2 desktop benchmark than much larger closed models, at about $1.10 per task.
